ambient_background.note: The current absolute tolerances are not repeated here as fractions; compare the max/p95 values above with the tolerances in the criterion block. If a tolerance is below the measured background, that field cannot have a continuous ambient run regardless of the physical shock.

threshold_sensitivity.note: Relative scales are multiplied by the ambient pressure, ambient density and a velocity reference (default 340 m/s). The table is diagnostic; no value is written back into the configuration.
